video_title: Melo Says Russell Westbrook’s Final Years Shouldn’t Define His Legacy

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook had the best tape of any guard in history
quotes.excerpt: Russell Westbrook probably got the best tape of any guard I've ever seen.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Russell Westbrook probably got the best tape of any guard I've ever seen. If we're just looking at Russ's highlights, we don't got to think about none of this. If I just showed somebody who never watched basketball Russell Westbrook highlights, they'd be like, 'That motherfucker is awesome.'

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Eye test. Just eye test, incredible.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook still has more to give in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I still think he has a little bit to give in the league.
quotes.quote: I still think he has a little bit to give in the league. I'm sure there's definitely a team I think he can help out there. But his career is so certified. I'm glad he went out on his own terms.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of free agency rumors on a veteran player
quotes.excerpt: It's a lot when you're at that point of your career to make those decisions.
quotes.quote: The impact that has on you as an individual is massive because now I got to answer to my wife, I got to answer to my family, I got to answer to my kids. It's a lot when you're at that point of your career to make those decisions. And I think just after he left the Wizards was when he started to feel that. Okay, I'm going to try to LA and go back home. It was a little easier because he was home in LA. Then it's like, damn, okay, where you going at now? I'm going to Denver. Where you at now? It's like, hell no. For what? Because we still love the game. And we know once we let it go, it's gone. It's gone forever.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The evolution of the point guard position in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The idea of what they want from a guard has changed.
quotes.quote: The idea of what they want from a guard has changed. You have to be able to shoot the ball. And that's the only thing that I think came to work against him towards the end of his career because now, for all the years you were able to use speed, you were able to use attack, force, athleticism, that got you to who you are today. That got you as a Hall of Famer playing that way. But now the game changes and now you got to shoot more threes and now he's still playing downhill, the way you should play. You should play downhill, but now the games is shifting and it keeps shifting.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's incredible discipline as a professional athlete
quotes.excerpt: What I was most impressed with Russ, and nobody is going to give him this, his discipline.
quotes.quote: What I was most impressed with Russ, and nobody is going to give him this, his discipline. His discipline as a player, because he's so wild, he's so erratic, and he's so on edge. The discipline that he had prior to that, I've never seen it before. He's disciplined. He coming to the arena six, seven hours before the game. He's disciplined. He eat his food, he get his workout in, he eat the right thing, he watches his film for three, four hours. Sometimes I'd be slapping the, 'Man, close that shit. You've been here since 3:00, nigga.' That's too much.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's legacy is cemented despite the outside noise
quotes.excerpt: Everything he's done, championship or not, is a plus. He was up against the odds.
quotes.quote: Everything he's done, championship or not, is a plus. He was up against the odds. I remember when he got drafted, it was called a reach by a lot of people. And think of how many players have come in the league since then that we call triple-double threats that could maybe probably average a triple-double for you. We say that about LeBron, say that about Wemby, say about all these guys. Only one person who's done it, and it's him and Joker and Oscar. History. So no matter what you try to do, that name is there, regardless of how much you try to diminish that. It's there, it's cemented. Triple-double king.
